sn35.162:1.1: atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.162:1.2: sādhu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn35.162:2.1: yaṃ kho koṭṭhita aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo:
sn35.162:2.3: cakkhuṃ kho koṭṭhita aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.162:2.4: rūpā aniccā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.162:2.5: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.162:2.6: cakkhusamphasso anicco, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.162:2.7: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn35.162:2.8: jivhā aniccā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.162:2.12: yampidaṃ jivhā samphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo. kāyo …pe…
sn35.162:2.13: mano anicco, tatra te chando pahātabbo;
sn35.162:2.17: yampidaṃ manosamphassa paccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.162:2.18: yaṃ kho koṭṭhita, aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabboti.
